telegramHelp.openLabel: How do I find my Telegram Chat ID?

step1.title: Open a chat with @userinfobot
step1.description: In the Telegram app, tap the search icon and search for "@userinfobot" — a free public bot that looks up your account info.

step2.title: Start the bot
step2.description: Tap "Start" (or send /start) to begin the conversation.

step3.title: Copy your Id
step3.description: The bot instantly replies with your account details. Copy the number next to "Id" — that's your Chat ID.

step4.title: Paste it here and say hello to our bot
step4.description: Paste the number into the Telegram Chat ID field below. Also make sure you've started a chat with our notification bot — Telegram only allows bots to message users who contacted them first.

step1.title: Welcome to Guest Mode
step1.description: You're browsing as a guest. Explore our curated AI research articles and knowledge graph — no account needed for this preview.

step1Member.title: Welcome Back
step1Member.description: Here's a quick refresher on what you can do — feel free to skip ahead at any time.

step2.title: Browse Articles
step2.description: The home page shows the latest AI research articles. Use the topic filter to focus on what interests you. As a guest, you can view the first page.

step3.title: Explore the Knowledge Graph
step3.description: The Graph page visualizes connections between articles and topics. As a guest, you'll see a preview with the first page of articles.

step4.title: Browse Tags
step4.description: The Tags page shows how articles are categorized. Explore tags to discover related topics and narrow down what you're reading.

step5.title: Switch Languages
step5.description: Use this menu to switch the app's display language — English and Traditional Chinese are supported.

step6.title: Light or Dark Mode
step6.description: Click to cycle between light, dark, and auto theme so the app matches your preference.

step7.title: Explore the Source Code
step7.description: This project is open source. Check out the GitHub repository to see how it's built or contribute.

step8.title: Read the Specs
step8.description: Browse the technical specifications and documentation behind this project's features.

step9.title: Stay Updated
step9.description: Check the release notes to see what's new — a red dot appears when there are unread updates.

step10.title: Get Full Access
step10.description: Sign in or create a free account to unlock full pagination, personalized settings, and the complete knowledge graph.

step10Member.title: You're All Set
step10Member.description: You can reopen this tour anytime from the help icon in the navigation bar.

chatIntro.title: New: AI Chat Assistant
chatIntro.description: Ask questions about the articles you're browsing and get answers grounded in their content.

chatPin.title: Pin Articles for Context
chatPin.description: Click the sparkles icon on an article to pin it as context for the AI chat, so your questions are answered using that article's content.

chatToggle.title: Ask the AI Assistant
chatToggle.description: Open the chat to ask questions about pinned articles or the topics you're browsing.

weeklyReportIntro.title: New: Weekly Reports
weeklyReportIntro.description: Every week, we summarize the most important articles for your topic into a single digest so you can catch up in minutes.

weeklyDatepicker.title: Jump to an Older Week
